copy.title: Copy token?
copy.message: Are you sure you want to copy your token? Your token can interact with all parts of Zipline. Do not share this token with anyone.

copied.title: Copied
copied.message: Your token has been copied to your clipboard.

refresh.title: Refresh token?
refresh.message: Are you sure you want to refresh your token? Once you refresh/reset your token, you will need to update any scripts or applications that use your token.

version.tooltip: Click to view more version information
version.latest: Running the latest version of Zipline.
version.unstable: You are running an unstable version of Zipline. Upstream versions are not fully tested and may contain bugs.
version.outdated: You are running an outdated version of Zipline. It is recommended to update to the latest version.
version.latestCommitNote: This is only visible when running an upstream version.

qrCode.title: QR Code
qrCode.copyUnsupported: Copying this format is not supported in some browsers. You can copy the image normally via right-click or holding it.
qrCode.copied: QR code image copied to clipboard
qrCode.copyFailed: Failed to copy QR code image

domainSelect.description: Override the domain with this value. This will change the domain returned in your uploads. Leave blank to use the default domain.

generic.title: An error occurred
generic.message: Something went wrong. Please try again later, or report this issue if it persists.

dashboard.title: Dashboard Client Error
dashboard.message: Something went wrong while loading the dashboard. Please try again later, or report this issue if it persists.

reload.title: Update available
reload.message: A new version of the app is available. Please reload the page to update.
reload.errorTitle: Failed to fetch dynamically imported module
reload.errorMessage: This error can occur when a new version of the app is deployed while you have the page open. Please reload the page to update to the latest version.
